📡   transmission from earth

Hi Hi Paps, Words really fail to capture how grateful I am for you. No matter where life takes me, I will always remember the sacrifices you made to give me a good life. Just as you have always been there for me, I will always be there for you too. Every mistake I've made and things I've done wrong were simply my own lessons to learn and my own way of experiencing life. It has never been a reflection of your parenting because you have been a truly good father to me. As you grow older, I pray you find peace and content in everything that surrounds you. Have an amazing birthday and always know I love you so so so much. ~Your Hanaru <3
